title: Survival
one_line: A neon arcade duel: blast laser fans at a growing viper pack as the Squirrel, or lead the pack as the Viper.
how_to_play: Tap once to start. Phone: drag left side to move, hold FIRE, tap NOVA. Computer: WASD + mouse/Space to shoot, E for Nova, T to change mode.
description: Five modes: Squirrel vs AI, two squirrels vs AI, Squirrel vs Viper (player vs player), Viper vs AI squirrel, and two vipers vs AI squirrels. Every level brings a bigger viper pack and the squirrel's power grows to match, so both sides always have the same total strength; against the AI, human players get a 10% edge. Levels 1 to 100 with one-tap level jump, touch controls, keyboard, mouse and game controller support.
